title: verify_payload_has_no_internal_fields is dead code in production — only tests call it
evidence: server/src/application/application_detail_handler.gleam:1138-1148: "/// §4.2 belt-and-braces: the SQL read already strips raw referee IP/UA from /// `result.fraud_signals.form_session` at the boundary; this re-verifies the /// serialized payload can never carry the internal-only markers, whatever the /// stored row contains (a spoofed/malformed payload can't leak internals)." then "pub fn verify_payload_has_no_internal_fields(payload: String) -> Bool {". Worktree grep: the only call sites are server/test/application/application_detail_handler_test.gleam:368/378/382/386/390; handle_get_detail and encode_reference_call never invoke it.
detail: The runtime serialization path never asserts the payload is clean; a future SQL read regression that re-introduces an internal field would ship to production unseen until the integration suite runs. SQL strip remains the real boundary (verified correct for all reachable writer shapes).
recommended_fix: Either call the guard on the serialized body in handle_get_detail (logging/failing on False), or demote the doc claim to 'test-only assertion' so the defense gap is explicit.

title: SQL ELSE branch passes non-object result shapes through verbatim; comment's 'cannot leak' invariant is false for string intermediates
evidence: list_reference_calls_for_detail.sql:35-37: "when any level is not an object the form_session key path cannot exist, so passing the result through verbatim cannot leak the §4.2 keys." and :40-47: "WHEN jsonb_typeof(result) = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof(result -> 'fraud_signals') = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof(result -> 'fraud_signals' -> 'form_session') = 'object' THEN (result #- '{fraud_signals,form_session,referee_ip}' #- '{fraud_signals,form_session,referee_user_agent}')::text ELSE result::text END". If fraud_signals/form_session is a JSON string containing escaped JSON, typeof != 'object' and the escaped keys travel in result::text; the handler's own escaped-marker list ("\\\"referee_ip\\\"") proves that wire form exists.
detail: The invariant is only true because every current writer (result.gleam structure_form_result/partial_result/minimal_terminal_result) emits objects — no writer emits a string intermediate, so no leak is reachable today. The corrupt-row test seeds only a scalar ('42'::jsonb), leaving the string-intermediate shape that would leak untested.
recommended_fix: Correct the comment to state the object-writer invariant, and add a corrupt-row test seeding fraud_signals/form_session as a JSON string containing the internal keys to pin the ELSE-branch behavior.
